8750.headline: Mid Ice Crisis blank Puckaneers 3-0
paragraphs: Thu Sep 17, at home at Rink 1: Mid Ice Crisis blank Puckaneers 3-0. That puts the season at 1-0.

Matthew Killeen opened the scoring at 10:05 of the second on the power play, from John Shortreed and Dylan Tadros (1-0). Christopher Mayor made it 2-0 at 1:47 of the second on the power play, from Alex Albano. ✎ Ryan Smith made it 3-0 at 2:44 of the third, from Kevin Zimmerman.

Scoring for Mid Ice Crisis: Christopher Mayor (1G), Matthew Killeen (1G) and Ryan Smith (1G). Game-winner: Matthew Killeen at 10:05 of the second. 6 PIM for Mid Ice Crisis (3 minors: High-Sticking, Roughing).
